newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - Evening Standard - May 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Evening Standard - May 28.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company WARNING OVER SLIMMING PILLS

A report from the Royal College of Physicians warned today that slimming pills should only be used by seriously overweight people, as they can result in dangerous side effects if given to the wrong sort of patient. Any doctor who flouts the new guidelines could face the General Medical Council. CENTRICA PRICE CUTS FACE OFGAS THREAT

Ofgas may seek to veto future price cuts by Centrica, the demerged supply arm of British Gas, a move which would require a change to Centrica's license. It is expected that Ofgas will confirm that Centrica's existing selective price cuts for direct-debit customers in the South West England will be allowed to stay, despite complaints from rival suppliers that they threatened competition.
AMERICAN T-BONDS CAST SHADOW ON EUROPE
American Treasury bond yields rose to over 7 percent last night, for the first time since 28 April, threatening to cast a shadow over European share and bond markets.
ABN Amro and Goldman Sachs have launched a $1bn (600m stg) bridging loan for Russian gas utility Gazprom, to be repaid from the proceeds of a planned $1bn Eurobond issue and $1bn convertible issue.
MOULINEX PLUGGING IN FOR FRANC BOND
Moulinex is to become the first issuer of junk bonds denominated in French francs. The issue is understood to be to pay for a rationalisation programme.
